confidence_notes: FX is the RBA rate for 18 Nov 2026, found via search of the RBA site. Food and drink anchors rest on one search of crowd-sourced cost-of-living data (MyLifeElsewhere, nomad.watch, Freenance). That search gave roughly RON 50 for an inexpensive meal, RON 15 for a cappuccino and RON 15 for a domestic beer. I did not search for mid-range meal, cocktail or wine prices. Those are estimated from the beer price and typical Romanian price relationships (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.3x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. July tourist and festival demand (e.g. Untold, Electric Castle) could push real prices higher.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Romanian price levels, with Cluj-Napoca about 20% above the national average. Comparable to other Central and Eastern European university and tech cities such as Brasov, Sibiu or Krakow, and a bit cheaper than Krakow.
